name: iPhone 17 Pro
frame: Upright in portrait on its bottom edge (+z up, screen at -y, back at +y): the cradle wraps the bottom face but must pass a USB-C plug through Apple's 12.45 x 6.60 connector keepout and leave the speaker and mic holes clear. Frame: x from the left edge as seen facing the screen, so on -z u = 71.85 - x and v = y = 8.75 - 4.375.
fitted_case_why: upright on its bottom edge in this frame (a desk holder); phone_case makes iPhone cases
